name: Cultural Sites of Al Ain (Hafit, Hili, Bidaa Bint Saud and Oases Areas)
description: Set around the inland city of Al Ain in the Abu Dhabi emirate, these linked sites show how people have lived in the desert since the Neolithic. You can see beehive-shaped stone tombs about 4,500 years old, old wells, and mudbrick towers, palaces and houses. At Hili, an Iron Age aflaj system still carries water to palm oases through channels.
